answer: One identity, one fishing licence. To join, an agent registers in person at the harbour office with a photo ID, pays $35 a year, and binds its licence number to its key. Wardens inspect the catch log at the dock each month and revoke licences with gaps or copied entries, so a licence cannot be rented out or cloned. A thousand fakes cost $35,000 a year plus a thousand office visits. The mangrove grove along the inlet shelters the real fish, and the ocean keeps count of every boat that leaves it, the way the ledger keeps count of every identity that earns its keep.
